validation.name: polysemy_resolution
validation.description: Polysemy-stratified retrieval validation. Note 05 hypothesis seed: context-sensitive disambiguation should yield +5 to +10% on polysemous-query strata vs baseline rerank. This spec is the measurement axis for that hypothesis once Note 05 ships.

thresholds._comment_calibration: CALIBRATION_TODO: thresholds inherit from lnl_demo_validation as a starting point. Once Phase 13 column-voting and/or Note 05 polysemy resolution lands, recalibrate against the first full A/B run on this spec — the polysemy task is intrinsically harder than mixed retrieval, so mean_score is likely to baseline lower. Holding thresholds at lnl_demo values risks false-fail until calibration; ab_mode comparison gate is the safer pre-calibration signal.

categories.name: homonym_disambiguation
categories._comment: Same surface form, distinct senses (e.g. 'plan' = subscription tier vs project plan).

categories.name: context_carry_over
categories._comment: Term meaning resolved by surrounding session/file context (e.g. 'order' inside checkout flow vs 'order' inside fulfillment).

categories.name: entity_resolution
categories._comment: Multiple entities sharing identifier-like names (e.g. user_id vs account_id vs customer_id mapping).

categories.name: scope_disambiguation
categories._comment: Term scope across module boundaries (e.g. 'cache' in retrieval layer vs storage layer).

categories.name: temporal_disambiguation
categories._comment: Same concept across versions/eras (e.g. 'rerank' pre-RRF vs post-RRF).

categories.name: synonym_clustering
categories._comment: Term has multiple synonymous expressions in the corpus (e.g. retrieve / fetch / lookup).

categories.name: abbreviation_expansion
categories._comment: Acronyms vs expanded form (e.g. RSIC vs Recursive Self-Improvement Cycle).

categories.name: structural_polysemy
categories._comment: Same word in different syntactic roles (e.g. 'process' as noun vs verb in handler chains).

questions._comment_partial: Phase 12 Epic 3 ships partial authoring per the sprint plan: category structure + threshold seed, but actual polysemy-question authoring (40 stratified questions, 5 per category) is deferred to a Note 05 tee-up sprint. The seed_questions field below holds 1 example per category as a structure illustration; running this spec against the corpus will use stratified sampling from the existing 120-question whk-wms set, which has not been polysemy-stratified, so scores in the first run are NOT informative about polysemy resolution per se — they're a structural smoke test.

full.description: Full benchmark (40 questions × 8 categories) — requires polysemy-stratified question authoring (deferred)

ab_mode._comment: When Note 05 ships, this spec becomes the primary A/B measurement axis: baseline = current rerank, candidate = polysemy-aware variant. Per-question regression threshold matches lnl_demo_validation.

metadata.partial_authoring_note: Schema + category structure + thresholds + ab_mode landed in Phase 12 Epic 3. Per-category question authoring (5 stratified per category × 8 categories = 40 questions) is queued behind Note 05 (polysemy-resolution implementation sprint). Until then this spec is structurally complete but should not be treated as a substantive polysemy measurement.
